specs.note: Store Printing Tips: 80 ℃ for 8 h in a blast drying oven, or 90 ℃ for 10 h on the heat bed. Wiki support guide: convection oven 75 °C, 8 h; heated bed 65 - 75 °C, 12 h; AMS 2 Pro 65 °C, 12 h; AMS HT 80 ℃, 12 h. Wiki drying table: forced-air oven 75-85 °C, 8-12 h; bed 90-100 °C, 12 h; AMS 2 Pro not compatible; AMS HT 80 °C, 12 h.
